description: This PHP source file defines the class Admin_UI_OrganisationSelectionField, which extends Admin_UI_Field. It manages the selection of organizations (advertisers and publishers) within an ad server admin interface, including rendering HTML select elements, handling permissions, and fetching relevant data from external data access classes.

classes.name: Admin_UI_OrganisationSelectionField
classes.description: A class for selecting organizations (advertisers and publishers) with permission checks, data fetching, and HTML rendering.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the selection field with default organization IDs and filter settings.

methods.name: _getAdvertisers
methods.description: Fetches a list of advertisers based on user permissions and filters.

methods.name: _getPublishers
methods.description: Fetches a list of publishers based on user permissions and filters.

methods.name: _hasAnonymousCampaigns
methods.description: Checks if there are any anonymous campaigns for the current user context.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders HTML select elements for advertisers and publishers, considering permissions and anonymous campaigns.

methods.name: setValueFromArray
methods.description: Sets the selected advertiser and publisher IDs from an input array.
